festivals.name: Chinese New Year (Spring Festival)
festivals.description: The most important Chinese holiday. Marks the start of the lunar new year.

festivals.name: Lantern Festival
festivals.description: 15th day of the first lunar month. Marks the end of CNY celebrations.

festivals.name: Qingming Festival (Tomb Sweeping)
festivals.description: Around April 4-6. Families visit ancestral graves. Avoid giving gifts on this day.

festivals.name: Dragon Boat Festival
festivals.description: Fifth day of fifth lunar month. Dragon boat races, zongzi rice dumplings.

festivals.name: Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day)
festivals.description: Seventh day of seventh lunar month. Chinese Valentine's Day.

festivals.name: Mid-Autumn Festival
festivals.description: 15th day of eighth lunar month. Mooncakes, family reunion, full moon.

festivals.name: Double Ninth Festival
festivals.description: Ninth day of ninth lunar month. Respecting elders, climbing mountains.

festivals.name: Winter Solstice Festival
festivals.description: Around December 21-22. Family reunion meal, tangyuan dumplings.
